Dear customer,

We cannot escalate non-payment issues to any other team here. If refunds or credits are warranted, the company that you made the original purchase with will take actions on their own.

We are unable to process refund requests here. If this order was placed through a third-party marketplace (like a company website) or platform (like an app), then please contact them directly for the best support.

The legal and fraud team will contact you on the next business day. If you continue to dispute your order, please reply to our original invoice notice email and provide your case ID. If you do not provide a case ID, a member in the fraud and legal department will not be able recognize your order. Please provide the case ID in the reply to our invoice notice to get assistance. Please note that the original invoice notice will only be sent to the email associated with the order if you received this email on a separate email address, please contact the legal, and fraud team directly for information.

Please let us know if you have any other questions.

Sincerely,

Your Tier 1 Customer Support Team.
